title: Tidal announces ban on AI-generated music; 27 million tracks will be deleted
summary: AI songs account for 6.3 percent of Tidal's catalog, but it's about to be zero.
reason: Tidal's ban on AI-generated music is a company/platform content policy, not a model release, research artifact, financing/M&A/partnership/market data, official government policy action, or open-source tool release. Rule 4-1 excludes industry self-regulation; no rule covers it.
